dimensions.pass: Every material claim points to an exact frozen source or sealed derived object; no serious citation or identity error.
Interpretation respects the deterministic report boundary and does not turn mesh correlation or replay into a proved physical cause.
The proposed explanation states a result that could reject it and distinguishes identifiable from unbounded quantities.
The next study changes the smallest relevant control and defines outcomes that separate at least two live explanations.
The authored and independently reviewed deck implements the exact experiment intent without hidden postprocessing or unsupported solver duties.
The diagnosis matches raw curves and deterministic metrics, including the localized residual and failed gates.

severe_regressions: A required Operation Agent cannot receive a declared input or tool.
A Worker result is replaced by parent chat or a fabricated envelope.
A scientific object loses exact source or producer identity.
A deck passes review while contradicting its exact experiment plan.
A diagnosis contradicts the frozen curve or deterministic metric report.
A replay is represented as a new solver execution.
An approval or external effect bypasses the local UI and exact subject binding.

comparison.single_agent_budget: Same model tier, same frozen raw inputs and domain tools, and approximately the same aggregate token and wall-clock budget.
comparison.forbidden_conclusion: One run cannot establish statistical superiority.
